newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cartel office probes D. Telekom.
newsitem.headline: German cartel office probes D. Telekom.

text.p: The German Cartel Office has begun an investigation against Deutsche Telekom on suspicion of anti-competitive practices in its cable television operations, a spokeswoman for the office said on Tuesday.

Private-sector broadcasters and programming producers have lodged complaints about Telekom's practices in limiting their access to its network, she said, confirming a story in Tuesday's Sueddeutsche Zeitung.
The daily quoted cartel office official Harald Luebbert, as saying cable broadcasters' access to the network could not be tied to commitments to buy other services from Deutsche Telekom.
The broadcasters also want Deutsche Telekom to start digital broadcasting and offer more channels on its cable network, which now has only 31, but will soon be expanded to 33.
Deutsche Telekom operates Germany's only nationwide cable network, serving 17 million households.
